payout_value_note: $50 Visa Reward Card to the referrer per qualifying checking referral. Cap ten cards ($500) per calendar year.
payout_quote: The person making the referral (Referrer) will earn a $50 Visa Reward Card for each individual referred ... A Referrer may receive up to ten (10) Visa Reward Cards ($500 value) within a calendar year ...
steps: Referrer registers for the program and shares the offer with friends, family, or coworkers.
Referred person registers via the referral link/email and opens a new InFirst Bank personal checking account.
Within 60 days of account opening, the friend sets up a direct deposit AND completes twelve debit card transactions (ATM excluded).
Referred person must not have had an InFirst Bank checking account within 90 days of opening.
Visa Reward Card delivered 4-6 weeks after all requirements are completed.
catches: Referrer cap: ten Visa Reward Cards ($500) per calendar year.
Friend must set up direct deposit AND complete 12 debit transactions within 60 days.
Rewards are Visa Reward Cards, not cash; may be reported as income to the IRS.
Allow 4-6 weeks after completion for card delivery.
Separate loan-referral tiers ($50 personal loan, $100 home equity, $150 mortgage) exist but are not this route.
biggest_catch: Capped at $500/year in Visa cards, and the friend must set up direct deposit AND complete 12 debit transactions within 60 days — with 4-6 weeks more for card delivery.
eligibility: InFirst Bank customers; referred person must be new to InFirst checking (no account in the prior 90 days).
timing: Registration + sharing ~5-10 min active; card delivered 4-6 weeks after all requirements completed.
